presets.label: Citrate gold monolayer — 2007
presets.note: Reported effective area: 40 nm² per tetramer. Preparation-specific monolayer estimate.

presets.label: Sparse simulated coating — Gurtovenko 2019
presets.note: Assumed 50% coverage with a 25 nm² footprint; reproduces 1 tetramer at 5 nm and 6 at 10 nm. Other sizes are area-scaled extrapolations.

presets.label: Dense optical estimate — 2017
presets.note: Approximately 30 tetramers inferred optically on 14.1 nm gold. Other sizes are area-scaled extrapolations, not measured counts.
